head.definition: The upper part of the human body containing the brain, eyes, ears, nose and mouth.
head.exampleUsage: The guide describes the head as the upper part of the body.

skull.definition: The bony framework of the head that encloses and protects the brain.
skull.exampleUsage: The skull protects the brain within its bony structure.

scalp.definition: The skin covering the top and back of the head beneath the hair.
scalp.exampleUsage: Dina learns that the scalp is the skin covering the head.

temple.definition: The flat side area of the head between the forehead and the ear.
temple.exampleUsage: The temple is the flat side area between forehead and ear.

crown.definition: The highest point or top part of the human head.
crown.exampleUsage: In anatomy crown refers to the highest point of the head.

forehead.definition: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.
forehead.exampleUsage: The forehead lies between the eyebrows and the hairline.

jaw.definition: The bony framework of the mouth holding the teeth.
jaw.exampleUsage: The jaw forms the structural framework of the mouth.

chin.definition: The projecting lower front area of the jaw below the mouth.
chin.exampleUsage: The chin is the projecting lower front area below the mouth.

neck.definition: The part of the body connecting the head with the trunk.
neck.exampleUsage: The neck connects the head with the rest of the body.

throat.definition: The passage through the front of the neck leading to the stomach and lungs.
throat.exampleUsage: The throat is the internal passage behind the mouth.

eye.definition: The sensory organ responsible for vision and sight.
eye.exampleUsage: The eye is the organ responsible for vision.

eyebrow.definition: The line of short hair growing above the eye socket.
eyebrow.exampleUsage: The eyebrow is the curved line of hair above the eye.

eyelid.definition: The protective fold of skin that covers and blinks over the eye.
eyelid.exampleUsage: The eyelid closes to protect the surface of the eye.

eyelash.definition: One of the short protective hairs fringing the edge of an eyelid.
eyelash.exampleUsage: An eyelash grows along the outer margin of the eyelid.

pupil.definition: The dark circular opening in the center of the iris that admits light.
pupil.exampleUsage: The pupil expands in dim light to let more light in.

iris.definition: The colored ring of muscle tissue behind the cornea that controls the pupil.
iris.exampleUsage: The iris gives the eye its distinctive color.

retina.definition: The light-sensitive layer of nerve tissue lining the back inside of the eye.
retina.exampleUsage: The retina converts light signals into nerve impulses.

cornea.definition: The clear, transparent outer dome covering the front of the eye.
cornea.exampleUsage: The cornea is the clear protective dome covering the iris.

tear-duct.definition: The small passage that drains tears from the eye into the nasal cavity.
tear-duct.exampleUsage: A tear duct drains excess tears away from the eye.

eye-socket.definition: The bony hollow in the skull that surrounds and protects the eyeball.
eye-socket.exampleUsage: The eye socket houses and protects the eyeball.

nose.definition: The protruding facial structure containing the nostrils for breathing and smelling.
nose.exampleUsage: The nose serves as the primary organ for smelling and breathing.

nostril.definition: Either of the two external openings of the nose.
nostril.exampleUsage: Each nostril allows air to pass into the nasal passages.

bridge-of-nose.definition: The firm, bony upper ridge of the human nose.
bridge-of-nose.exampleUsage: Glasses rest comfortably across the bridge of the nose.

mouth.definition: The facial opening through which food is ingested and vocal sounds are produced.
mouth.exampleUsage: The mouth contains the teeth, tongue and palate.

lip.definition: Either of the two fleshy margins forming the border of the mouth.
lip.exampleUsage: The lip forms the outer movable edge of the mouth.

upper-lip.definition: The fleshy margin of the mouth located above the oral opening.
upper-lip.exampleUsage: The upper lip sits directly beneath the base of the nose.

lower-lip.definition: The fleshy margin of the mouth located below the oral opening.
lower-lip.exampleUsage: The lower lip rests above the curve of the chin.

tongue.definition: The muscular organ in the floor of the mouth used in tasting and speech.
tongue.exampleUsage: The tongue helps in tasting food and forming spoken words.

palate.definition: The roof of the mouth separating the oral and nasal cavities.
palate.exampleUsage: The palate forms the roof of the oral cavity.

gums.definition: The firm pink mucosal tissue surrounding and supporting the teeth.
gums.exampleUsage: Healthy gums support and surround the base of each tooth.

ear.definition: The external and internal organ of hearing and bodily balance.
ear.exampleUsage: The ear detects sound waves and assists with physical balance.

earlobe.definition: The soft, fleshy lower portion of the external ear.
earlobe.exampleUsage: The earlobe is the soft lower part of the outer ear.

ear-canal.definition: The tubular canal leading from the outside ear to the eardrum.
ear-canal.exampleUsage: Sound travels down the ear canal to reach the eardrum.

eardrum.definition: The thin membrane separating the outer and middle ear that vibrates with sound.
eardrum.exampleUsage: Sound waves cause the eardrum to vibrate.

inner-ear.definition: The internal part of the ear containing the cochlea and balance organs.
inner-ear.exampleUsage: The inner ear houses delicate organs of hearing and balance.

outer-ear.definition: The visible external flap and ear canal leading to the eardrum.
outer-ear.exampleUsage: The outer ear collects incoming acoustic sound waves.

hearing.definition: The auditory sense by which sound vibrations are perceived.
hearing.exampleUsage: Hearing allows learners to perceive spoken words and sounds.

sound-wave.definition: A traveling pattern of acoustic disturbance through the air.
sound-wave.exampleUsage: A sound wave travels through air before entering the ear.

balance.definition: The biological ability to maintain physical stability and posture.
balance.exampleUsage: Organs in the inner ear help maintain physical balance.

cochlea.definition: The spiral, fluid-filled snail-shell-like organ in the inner ear for hearing.
cochlea.exampleUsage: The cochlea converts sound vibrations into electrical signals.

tooth.definition: A hard, calcified structure anchored in the jaw used for biting and chewing.
tooth.exampleUsage: Each tooth is anchored firmly within the jawbone.

incisor.definition: One of the sharp, flat front teeth used for cutting food.
incisor.exampleUsage: An incisor cuts into food with its sharp chisel edge.

canine.definition: A pointed tooth located between the incisors and premolars.
canine.exampleUsage: The canine tooth has a pointed shape suited for tearing.

molar.definition: A broad back tooth with a flat surface used for grinding food.
molar.exampleUsage: A molar grinds food in the rear of the jaw.

premolar.definition: A transitional tooth situated between the canine and molar teeth.
premolar.exampleUsage: The premolar sits between the canine and molar teeth.

wisdom-tooth.definition: One of the four third molars that typically erupt in early adulthood.
wisdom-tooth.exampleUsage: A wisdom tooth is a third molar that emerges later in life.

baby-tooth.definition: A temporary primary tooth developed during infancy and shed later.
baby-tooth.exampleUsage: A baby tooth is shed as permanent teeth develop.

enamel.definition: The hard mineralized white outer surface layer of a tooth crown.
enamel.exampleUsage: Enamel protects the crown of the tooth from decay.

root.definition: The lower anatomical portion of a tooth embedded within the jaw socket.
root.exampleUsage: The tooth root anchors the tooth firmly in the jaw.

hair.definition: Threadlike keratin filaments growing from follicles in the scalp and skin.
hair.exampleUsage: Hair grows from microscopic follicles in the scalp.

hairline.definition: The visible edge or margin along which scalp hair begins on the forehead.
hairline.exampleUsage: The hairline marks the border where scalp hair starts.

part.definition: The line formed by combing hair in opposite directions on the scalp.
part.exampleUsage: She combed her hair to create a neat part on the side.

strand.definition: A single individual hair filament or slender thread.
strand.exampleUsage: A single strand of hair was visible under the magnifier.

beard.definition: Hair that grows on the lower face, cheeks and chin of an adult.
beard.exampleUsage: A neat beard covers the lower jaw and chin.

mustache.definition: Hair growing on the upper lip beneath the nose.
mustache.exampleUsage: A mustache grows along the skin of the upper lip.

sideburns.definition: Strips of facial hair growing down the sides of the face in front of the ears.
sideburns.exampleUsage: His sideburns extend down beside each ear.

stubble.definition: Short, bristly facial hair emerging shortly after shaving.
stubble.exampleUsage: Short stubble was visible on his chin the next day.

goatee.definition: A small neat beard confined to the chin area below the lower lip.
goatee.exampleUsage: A goatee is a small beard styled on the chin.

braid.definition: A hairstyle created by interlacing three or more sections of hair.
braid.exampleUsage: She gathered her hair into a neat woven braid.
